prompt: Walk me through DORA's major-incident reporting deadlines. Do weekends count?
assertions: Initial report: within 4 hours of classification AND no later than 24 hours from awareness
Intermediate report: within 72 hours from submission of the initial notification
Final report: no later than one month from the (latest) intermediate report
States the weekend/bank-holiday relief: next working day by noon (with the carve-out for significant credit institutions)
Cites CDR (EU) 2025/301 as the source of the time limits
